protocol.target: top3 distinct two-digit suffix picks; hit if >=1 appears among 27 XSMB prizes
protocol.ordering: predict -> lock 3 picks -> reveal result -> score -> online update
protocol.leakage_guard: candidate/hyperparameter selection uses only the development window ending before the final holdout
protocol.important_baseline_note: 50% is below the fair random top-3 baseline, so success is judged against ~56.06%, not 50%.

selected_model.name: long_l10_lr010
selected_model.selected_by: highest development top3 hit rate; tie-break lower development Brier; never by holdout

holdout.promotion_rule: Do not claim predictive edge unless holdout beats the random baseline with practically meaningful lift and uncertainty supports it.
